# Edge Ecosystem

> Public website of ООО «ЭДЖ ЭКОСИСТЕМА» (Edge Ecosystem LLC). The company builds CRM, internal portals, integrations and automation, and coordinates software delivery. EdgeFocus, written as one word, is its project and task system.

Partnership terms are agreed individually. The partner pages state that no standard commission is offered. The Edge name and logo may be used only with prior written permission from the company. Clients pay the company, using the official details on the company page, not a partner.
